Mitoshi is a **static web app**. No Mitoshi server holds keys, balances or the map of your wallets: there is a relay
and a gateway that pass sealed requests, and neither sees both ends.

## The system map

<Diagram name="system-map" alt="System map: the Mitoshi app, its Zcash wallet and per-position keys in the browser send every user call over Oblivious HTTP to a Cloudflare relay that sees the IP, then to a Vercel gateway in Dublin that sees the request, then to allowlisted upstreams: the Zcash light server, NEAR Intents 1Click, and Polymarket, Hyperliquid and Jupiter. Public prices come through the relay." caption="The map in the README, rendered from .github/diagrams/readme-system.mmd in light and dark." />

The detailed map: every part in the browser, both lanes through the relay, and every upstream.

## The money's route

<Diagram name="funding-flow" alt="Funding round trip: at a random moment, your shielded ZEC sends one standard amount with a fresh shielded refund address to NEAR Intents, which pays USDC, pUSD or SOL to a fresh wallet in a confidential swap; the wallet opens one position on the venue, closes it, sends the proceeds back through NEAR Intents to a fresh shielded address. A copy trader finds one funding, one trade, no history." caption="The README's funding round trip, from .github/diagrams/readme-funding.mmd." />

## In the browser

| Piece | Package | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Wallet worker | `packages/zwallet` | Zcash's `zcash_client_sqlite` 0.23 on `wasm32-wasip1`, in a Web Worker: sync, notes, proofs, sends |
| Vault | `apps/web` | IndexedDB, every record AES-GCM encrypted under a non-extractable key, optionally wrapped by a passphrase |
| Engine | `packages/engine` | Standard sizes, rest rules, random scheduling, the wallet registry, the leak meter, key paths (BIP 32, SLIP-0010) |
| Rails | `packages/rails` | NEAR 1Click quotes, deposits and status; every quote's ed25519 signature checked |
| Venues | `packages/venues` | Polymarket (official SDK in its own worker), Polymarket Perps, Hyperliquid (`@nktkas/hyperliquid` SDK), Solana (Jupiter Ultra) |
| OHTTP | `packages/net` | The RFC 9458 client and the gateway's pinned key |
| Chart | `packages/chart` | A canvas engine for live lines and candles |

## On the network

| Service | Where | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mitoshi-web` | Cloudflare Worker, targeted placement near AWS eu-west-1 | Serves the static app with strict headers, relays sealed messages, proxies public pictures, holds one live feed per venue in a Durable Object |
| `mitoshi-gateway` | Vercel Function, Dublin (`dub1`) | Opens each sealed message, calls only the allowlist, seals the answer; holds the NEAR partner key and the Polymarket builder secret |
| `mitoshi-docs` | Cloudflare Worker, static assets | This site |
